|---|---|---|
| Zero percent preserves total | Covered | `zero percent preserves total` asserts `discount(100,0) === 100` at [tests/cart.test.mjs:4](tests/cart.test.mjs:4). |
| Ordinary percentage discount | Missing | Required `discount(200,25) === 150` has no assertion. This distinguishes percentage calculation from subtracting a fixed amount. |
